explanation: This fires only at D1 of a trial whose previous trial was a1, a common transition to S1, and no reward: then it is about 10 late in the episode (trial 70 onward) and about 7-8 earlier. Everywhere else it is 0, including every GO and D2 step, D1 after any rewarded trial, and D1 after an unrewarded trial that used a2 or reached its state through a rare transition.
